commandDescription.zh-CN: 交互式管理模型发现 provider（添加/删除/重新发现），写入 models.json 并立即生效
commandDescription.en-US: Interactively manage model-discovery providers (add/remove/rediscover); changes are written to models.json and take effect immediately

refreshDescription.zh-CN: 强制刷新网关模型列表、元数据 JSON 和本地缓存
refreshDescription.en-US: Refresh gateway models, metadata JSON and the local cache

refreshEmpty.zh-CN: models.json 中没有标记 discoverModels 的 provider，可用 /config:model-discovery 添加
refreshEmpty.en-US: No provider in models.json is marked with discoverModels; add one with /config:model-discovery

refreshDone.zh-CN: 模型刷新完成：{ok}/{total} 个 provider 成功

commandValueUnsupported.zh-CN: 发现请求不支持 "!command" 形式的配置值
commandValueUnsupported.en-US: Discovery requests do not support "!command" configuration values

headerSkipped.zh-CN: {id}: header "{key}" {reason}，该 header 未随发现请求发送
headerSkipped.en-US: {id}: header "{key}" {reason}; this header was not sent with the discovery request

missingConfig.zh-CN: 缺少 {field}，无法注册模型发现

discoveryFailed.zh-CN: {id}: 模型发现失败（{reason}）；保留匹配配置的缓存或 models.json 手写模型
discoveryFailed.en-US: {id}: model discovery failed ({reason}); keeping matching cached models or handwritten models in models.json

offlineNoCache.zh-CN: 尚无已发现的模型（上次发现失败），离线初始化跳过
offlineNoCache.en-US: No discovered models yet (last discovery failed); skipping offline initialization

cacheReadFailed.zh-CN: 模型缓存读取失败（已忽略，将重新发现）：{reason}
cacheReadFailed.en-US: Failed to read the model cache (ignored; will rediscover): {reason}

cacheWriteFailed.en-US: Failed to write the model cache: {reason}

title.zh-CN: 模型发现 provider（共 {count} 个）

providerId.zh-CN: provider id（小写字母/数字/中划线，如 my-proxy）
providerId.en-US: Provider id (letters, numbers, hyphens; e.g. my-proxy)

invalidId.zh-CN: id 只能包含字母、数字、中划线，且不能以中划线开头
invalidId.en-US: The id may contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens, and cannot start with a hyphen

invalidUrl.zh-CN: baseUrl 必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
invalidUrl.en-US: baseUrl must start with http:// or https://

confirmAdd.en-US: Add this provider and write it to models.json?

discovered.zh-CN: {id}: 已发现并注册 {count} 个模型，/model 中即可选用
discovered.en-US: {id}: discovered and registered {count} models; they are available in /model

firstFailed.zh-CN: {id}: 配置已保存，但首次发现失败；服务恢复后可在 /config:model-discovery 中重新发现
firstFailed.en-US: {id}: configuration saved, but initial discovery failed; rediscover with /config:model-discovery after the service recovers

removeMessage.zh-CN: 将从 models.json 移除该 provider 并注销其模型。此操作可重新添加恢复。
removeMessage.en-US: This removes the provider and unregisters its models from models.json. It can be added again later.

panelTitle.zh-CN: 模型发现 provider（共 {count} 个）

panelDescAdd.zh-CN: 填入 id、baseUrl、api 后写入 models.json 并立即发现模型。
panelDescAdd.en-US: Enter an id, baseUrl and api; the entry is written to models.json and models are discovered immediately.

panelDescEnabled.zh-CN: 关闭后去掉该 provider 的 discoverModels 标记，模型条目不参与发现（provider 本身保留）。
panelDescEnabled.en-US: Turning this off removes the discoverModels marker so this provider is no longer discovered; the provider entry itself is kept.

panelDescName.zh-CN: 模型列表里显示的名字；留空回落到 provider id。
panelDescName.en-US: Name shown in the model list; empty falls back to the provider id.

panelDescBaseUrl.zh-CN: 发现请求打向 {baseUrl}/models；必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。
panelDescBaseUrl.en-US: Discovery requests go to {baseUrl}/models; it must start with http:// or https://.

panelDescApi.zh-CN: Pi 用哪种协议与这个 provider 对话。
panelDescApi.en-US: Which protocol Pi uses to talk to this provider.

panelDescRediscover.zh-CN: 立刻请求 {baseUrl}/models 刷新模型列表并更新缓存。
panelDescRediscover.en-US: Requests {baseUrl}/models now, refreshes the model list and updates the cache.

panelDescRemove.zh-CN: 从 models.json 移除该 provider 并注销其模型，会先让你确认。
panelDescRemove.en-US: Removes the provider and unregisters its models from models.json; you are asked to confirm first.

panelRemoveMessage.zh-CN: 将从 models.json 移除该 provider 并注销其模型。此操作可重新添加恢复。
panelRemoveMessage.en-US: This removes the provider and unregisters its models from models.json. It can be added again later.

panelProviderMissing.zh-CN: models.json 中找不到 provider「{id}」的条目，无法写回。
panelProviderMissing.en-US: models.json has no entry for provider "{id}"; the change cannot be written back.

invalidMetadataUrl.zh-CN: 元数据 URL 必须使用 HTTP(S)，且不能包含用户名或密码
invalidMetadataUrl.en-US: Metadata URL must use HTTP(S) and contain no username or password

invalidMetadataCatalog.zh-CN: 元数据响应不是有效的模型列表或 models.dev 目录
invalidMetadataCatalog.en-US: Metadata response is not a valid model list or models.dev catalog

metadataFailed.zh-CN: {id}: 元数据查询失败（{reason}）；继续使用端点元数据和默认值
metadataFailed.en-US: {id}: metadata lookup failed ({reason}); continuing with endpoint metadata and defaults

panelDescModelsUrl.zh-CN: 可选的完整模型列表 URL；留空使用 baseUrl 下的 /models。该列表决定可用模型。
panelDescModelsUrl.en-US: Optional complete model-list URL; empty uses /models under baseUrl. This list determines available models.

panelDescMetadataUrl.zh-CN: 用 https://models.dev/api.json 或模型列表 API 补齐元数据；留空关闭。不会发送 provider 的凭证。
panelDescMetadataUrl.en-US: Fill metadata gaps using https://models.dev/api.json or a model-list API; empty disables lookup. Provider credentials are never sent.

panelDescMetadataProvider.zh-CN: 可选的 models.dev provider id（如 anthropic），用于确定模型元数据来源；留空按精确 ID 匹配。
panelDescMetadataProvider.en-US: Optional models.dev provider id (such as anthropic) to select the metadata source; empty uses exact ID matching.

metadataWriteFailed.zh-CN: 模型元数据 JSON 写入失败：{reason}
metadataWriteFailed.en-US: Failed to write model metadata JSON: {reason}

metadataCached.zh-CN: 元数据刷新失败（{reason}）；使用 metadata.json 中的上次成功目录
metadataCached.en-US: Metadata refresh failed ({reason}); using the last successful catalog from metadata.json

panelDescRefreshOnStartup.zh-CN: 每次启动刷新模型列表和元数据；失败保留缓存。关闭后仅在缓存缺失或手动刷新时联网。
panelDescRefreshOnStartup.en-US: Refresh models and metadata on each startup; retain cached data on failure. Turn off to use cached startup until an explicit refresh.

modelTestDescription.zh-CN: 测试当前模型或指定 provider/model；provider/* 或 all 逐个测试（会发送小型真实请求）
modelTestDescription.en-US: Test the current model or provider/model; provider/* or all tests sequentially (sends small real requests)

modelTestTimeout.zh-CN: 模型测试超过时间限制
modelTestTimeout.en-US: Model test exceeded its time limit

modelTestEmptyReply.zh-CN: 模型返回空文本；未确认可用
modelTestEmptyReply.en-US: Model returned no text; availability was not confirmed

modelTestRunning.zh-CN: 已有模型测试正在运行
modelTestRunning.en-US: A model test is already running

modelTestNoTarget.zh-CN: 找不到唯一模型或 provider：{target}。用 /model 选择模型，或 /model_test provider/model、provider/*、all。
modelTestNoTarget.en-US: No unique model or provider found: {target}. Select a model with /model, or use /model_test provider/model, provider/*, all.

modelTestStarted.zh-CN: 正在测试 {count} 个模型（每次请求最多 64 个输出 token，超时 30 秒）
modelTestStarted.en-US: Testing {count} models (up to 64 output tokens and 30 seconds per request)

modelTestSummary.zh-CN: 模型测试完成：{passed} 个通过，已测试 {tested}/{total} 个

panelDescModelIdRegex.zh-CN: 区分大小写的 JavaScript 正则表达式，如 ^claude-；不加 / 分隔符或标志，留空不过滤。
panelDescModelIdRegex.en-US: Case-sensitive JavaScript regex source, e.g. ^claude-; no / delimiters or flags. Empty keeps all IDs.
